# Knowledge Base MCP connectors

6 knowledge base connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All knowledge base connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/knowledge](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/knowledge).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Agent Skills Finder](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/agent-skills-to-mcp) | Find the best public Agent Skill (SKILL.md) for a task, read it from GitHub and reuse it: search millions of skills, check licence and version, apply the method, and save it as a workspace skill. | 7 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-agent-skills-to-muse) |
| [GitBook](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/gitbook-to-mcp) | Drive GitBook (docs platform) from any AI agent: spaces, pages, content, search, collections. 9 tools, Bearer auth. | 9 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-gitbook-to-muse) |
